# Pilot planning worksheet

Complete with the participating teacher before freezing the protocol.

| Planning item | Teacher/researcher entry |
|---|---|
| Curriculum authority, document edition, language and grade | |
| Unit and intended learners | |
| Responsible teacher/researcher | |
| Frozen map and bank versions | |
| Primary question: feasibility or independent diagnostic agreement | |
| Cohort recruitment and data-collection arrangements | |
| Separate assessment ID and item IDs | |
| Per-skill mastery rubric and treatment of partial/ambiguous answers | |
| Independent assessor and how diagnosis will remain hidden | |
| Planned diagnostic and reference assessment dates | |
| Intervening teaching between assessments and how it will be recorded | |
| Pseudonymous student-ID convention | |
| Missing responses and exclusion rules | |
| Prespecified split seed, holdout fraction and parameter sensitivity | |
| Expected cohort size and rationale agreed with research collaborator | |
| Where records will be stored and who will manage access | |

During the pilot, record attendance, scan corrections, time required, interruptions,
teacher usability feedback and deviations from this plan. Preserve the original
protocol; document amendments separately. Do not select the best sensitivity result
after seeing outcomes and present it as a prespecified final result.
